newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Kenshodo says to list shares on UK's AIM.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kenshodo says to list shares on UK's AIM.

text.p: Unlisted Japanese herbal medicine company Kenshodo Pharmaceutical Ltd said on Wednesday that it would list its shares on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) as early as in September.
The listing would make Kenshodo the first Japanese company to float shares on AIM, which lists small firms and start-up companies, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun daily said on Wednesday.
Kenshodo would also be the first Japanese firm to list shares overseas without listing them in Japan, the paper said.
It said Kenshodo would increase its capital at the time of its AIM listing by issuing one million new shares to raise between 1.5 billion to three billion yen.
Kenshodo, which makes and sells herbal medicine, would not comment on the newspaper report.
